sequence_8_failure.screen_at_failure: Android launcher with no visible Files icon

root_cause.summary: The source-side Files policy used press_back from empty Downloads, which exits to the launcher, then alternated with open_app; once the loop guard blocked open_app, its generic higher-level repair did not explain how to re-enter an app whose launcher icon was not visible.
details: The correct source-side navigation from Downloads is the visible top-left roots drawer, not press_back.
At the launcher, open_app is the natural API-level action but was already part of the blocked alternating cycle.
The existing loop repair forbade repetition but gave no launcher-specific alternative.
The deterministic repair therefore repeated open_app and was correctly rejected without execution.

semantic_reliability_findings.b3_contacts_observation: The model entered the requested phone number while Company was visibly focused, then saved; the native evaluator still returned 1.0.
semantic_reliability_findings.m0_contacts_observation: M0 dismissed the keyboard, selected the visible Phone field, entered the same number there, saved, and confirmed the contact detail; native reward was 1.0.
semantic_reliability_findings.b3_expense_observation: All requested values and Donation were visible, but the final screenshot still showed the unsaved Expense Entry form with the SAVE button; max_steps evaluation returned 1.0.
semantic_reliability_findings.m0_expense_observation: The model exhausted the budget before selecting Donation or saving; native reward was 0.0.
semantic_reliability_findings.analysis_policy: Preserve official native rewards for preregistered Gate accounting and report semantic completion separately; do not retroactively change evaluator thresholds.

mechanism: Add a Files source-navigation contract: from Downloads, use the visible top-left roots drawer rather than press_back/reopen_app.
When LOOP_GUARD rejects open_app, make the sole repair action-specific: do not repeat open_app or press_back; on the launcher, tap a visible target app icon or swipe upward to reveal the app drawer.
Do not inject an app icon coordinate, silently rewrite an action, add a repair, or weaken the loop guard.
preserved_controls: Same seed, task instances, 8-cell schedule, step budgets, model-call budgets, evaluator, acceptance thresholds, and model identity
Same one bounded repair and identical-action thresholds
No evaluator state or hidden task parameters exposed
Fresh sequence-8 development reproduction before any new formal suite
